summary: Implemented cycle-11 pipe OD retrieval normalization. The canonicalizer now adds a single guarded DN-enriched alternate for supported valve-family queries with one explicit, millimetre-qualified pipe OD cue using the allowlisted 108 mm -> DN 100 mapping. It preserves the source query, refuses explicit DN conflicts, unmapped/bare/unqualified/multiple dimensions, and unsupported/no-product text. No matcher, hybrid retriever, index, catalog, GOLD, or harness files were changed. OpenSpec tasks are 5/5 complete and strict validation passes.
